description: This file defines the CellStyleAssessor class, which evaluates conditional formatting rules on spreadsheet cells and merges applicable styles based on conditions.

classes.name: CellStyleAssessor
classes.description: A class for assessing conditional styles on a cell in a spreadsheet and merging applicable styles based on conditions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CellStyleAssessor with a specific cell and conditional range, setting up helpers for matching and merging styles.

methods.name: matchConditions
methods.description: Evaluates each conditional style against the cell; if conditions are met, merges the style and stops if indicated.
